names.why: Bored, lazy, exhausted and serious are covered only loosely, but acceptable as the low-energy tile.
Quiet feelings (lonely, guilt, sorrow) are a stretch for 'Drama' but a teenager would look for them here.

notes: No clear misplacement. 5185 'kindness' (in Joy) and 5404 'greedy' / 5567 'arrogant' / 7239 'idiot' (in Drama) are traits rather than moods but sit on the right side.
